description: Header file defining interface for NPM1300 multi-function device driver in Zephyr OS, including enums, function prototypes for register access, power management, and callback handling.

methods.name: mfd_npm1300_reg_read_burst
methods.description: Reads multiple registers from the NPM1300 device.

methods.name: mfd_npm1300_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a single register from the NPM1300 device.

methods.name: mfd_npm1300_reg_write
methods.description: Writes a single register to the NPM1300 device.

methods.name: mfd_npm1300_reg_write2
methods.description: Writes two registers to the NPM1300 device.

methods.name: mfd_npm1300_reg_update
methods.description: Updates specific bits in a register of the NPM1300 device.

methods.name: mfd_npm1300_set_timer
methods.description: Sets the timer register in the NPM1300 device.

methods.name: mfd_npm1300_reset
methods.description: Performs a full power reset of the NPM1300 device.

methods.name: mfd_npm1300_hibernate
methods.description: Puts the NPM1300 device into low power hibernate mode.

methods.name: mfd_npm1300_add_callback
methods.description: Adds a GPIO callback for NPM1300 events.

methods.name: mfd_npm1300_remove_callback
methods.description: Removes a GPIO callback for NPM1300 events.
